text: If you are flying the airplane, you should do nothing but fly. If there is anything you need, just call for it. This includes gear, flaps, lights, radio frequencies, coffee, anything you wish. The pilot flying should, however, keep one ear turned to ATC, even though the other pilot is doing the communicating. Question. What should the pilot flying do except flying the airplane?
